messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000710": INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000416" [constraint]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, the full reindex)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000714": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000742": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, the marketing send)
- memory_id "1000718" [decision]: Reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000838": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000706": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000802" [decision]: As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000567": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000810" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000332" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog, image metadata)
- memory_id "1000778": As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000623" [constraint]: The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000604": Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: team Dune, image resizer, the runtime upgrade)
Existing entity names: indexer, INC-2025-023, Atlas team, OpenSearch 2.11, the full reindex, product catalog, Cinder team, ledger service, reindex jobs, image resizer, the marketing send, billing API, the bus, reporting service, Boreal team, the dependency bump, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Ember team, image metadata, feature-flags, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade, team Dune

The note:

[2025-12-18] standup/atlas/2025-12-18: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.

Also mentions catalog writes — product catalog? "instead of on every catalog write" — could relate to product catalog. Add relation? Maybe indexer depends_on product catalog already exists. The decision: indexer rebuilds index nightly instead of on every catalog write.

Add fact: "As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes." Entities: indexer. Maybe product catalog too since "catalog write". I'll include product catalog.

Alias: search-indexer → indexer.

Relation? Not clearly a two-entity relation. Skip.
